techniques.evidence: src/hooks/utility/interaction/useMotion.ts:56 one reduced-motion signal from both the OS query and the in-app data-motion toggle; derived, not re-detected, at src/hooks/utility/interaction/useProgressiveReveal.ts:89

src/hooks/utility/interaction/useRovingTabIndex.ts:11 position keyed by activeIndex:number (identity-survives-reuse names index keying as the failure) and the hook has no consumer in src/, so composites re-derive arrow handling per widget (src/features/shared/components/layout/SegmentedTabs.tsx:83, src/features/shared/components/layout/PanelTabBar.tsx:59) while 7 of 13 role=tablist files have no arrow model at all

src/hooks/utility/interaction/useRovingTabIndex.ts:9 the one shared behavior door exists but is outside every call site, so wrap/Home/End/orientation diverge across 6 hand-rolled copies - near-primitives the technique says to consolidate

src/hooks/utility/interaction/useCopyToClipboard.ts:44 the canonical copy door exposes the transient outcome only as state for a label swap and never routes it to the announcer (src/features/shared/components/feedback/AriaLiveProvider.tsx:135 exists); 0 of 43 consumers announce, the half-move the transient-outcome rule names
src/hooks/utility/interaction/useSettingsSaveToast.ts:18 save confirmation is requested through the toast layer rather than a hook-owned region; the copy hooks are the gap recorded above
